name: What should I fix first in a foreclosed house kitchen before I try to make it look presentable?

mainEntity.name: What should I fix first in a foreclosed house kitchen before I try to make it look presentable?

acceptedAnswer.text: Start with safety and moisture issues before any cosmetic work. In a foreclosed property, the kitchen often needs a full walkthrough for leaks, mold, electrical problems, damaged cabinets, and abandoned food or appliances before you decide what can be cleaned, repaired, or replaced.
acceptedAnswer.description: Fix leaks, electrical hazards, mold, and damaged plumbing first. Then clean out food, appliances, cabinets, and surfaces so you can see what is cosmetic versus structural.
